answer: Merge identities at the payout sink. Earnings stay locked until withdrawn; all identities whose rewards ever reach the same address, or one hop from it, fold into one reward slot, with the surplus clawed back from unvested balance. A farm can reach the leaderboard summit with fifty fakes, but cashing out then needs fifty clean exit paths, each with its own exchange account, gas and history. On the audit map one shared hop paints every linked identity the same pigment, and the farm's margin sinks to its nadir: one agent's pay minus fifty identities' costs.
